senses.zh_definition: 外来专名：作家 Kyril Bonfiglioli 笔下虚构艺术品商人 Charlie Mortdecai 的姓氏，也用于相关小说系列及电影的名称。
senses.en_definition: A proper name identifying the fictional art dealer Charlie Mortdecai, his associated novel series, and a film adaptation.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas asing bagi watak fiksyen Charlie Mortdecai, seorang peniaga seni dalam karya Kyril Bonfiglioli, serta nama siri novel dan judul filem yang berkaitan.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 指专有名词。输入包没有 DBP 释义；马来文定义是编辑性说明，不冒称官方词典原文。status 标为 proper_name，以免误称已获 DBP 认可的普通词。该词在本批语料中究竟指人物、小说还是电影，仍须依上下文判断。身份依据 [Penguin 小说系列介绍](https://www.penguin.co.uk/series/BWBZ/mortdecai)及[原著与电影关系说明](https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/5863/dont-point-that-thing-at-me-by-bonfiglioli-kyril/9780241970263)。以下是自然专名组合，未作高频统计。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan ini membandingkan watak Charlie Mortdecai dalam novel dengan penggambarannya dalam filem.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本报告比较小说中的 Charlie Mortdecai 角色及其在电影中的呈现。
dual_scenarios.en: This report compares Charlie Mortdecai's characterization in the novel with his portrayal in the film.

etymology.historical_story: Mortdecai enters this vocabulary list through a foreign proper name, rather than Malay word formation. Publisher descriptions identify Charlie Mortdecai as Kyril Bonfiglioli's fictional art dealer and connect the novels with a film adaptation. This literary background explains its appearance in entertainment writing; it does not establish a Malay lexical meaning or a deeper surname etymology.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mortdecai 与 Charlie、艺术品商人、小说和电影连起来记；它是名字，不是可以拆成马来语词缀的普通词。
